title: Jaisalmer: 11% of Rajasthan's Land, Under 1% of Its People

beats.say: Eleven percent of Rajasthan's land holds under one percent of its people.
beats.caption: 11% of Rajasthan's land · under 1% of its people (2011 census)

beats.say: It's Jaisalmer district, in India's Thar Desert.
beats.caption: Jaisalmer district · Thar Desert, north-west India

beats.say: Census twenty eleven: seventeen people per square kilometre, less than a tenth of the state average.
beats.caption: 17 people per km² · Rajasthan average 200 (2011 census)

beats.say: Least dense of Rajasthan's thirty-three districts, in twenty eleven.
beats.caption: Least dense of Rajasthan's 33 districts (2011 census)

beats.say: Sparse, not empty: about six hundred and seventy thousand people.
beats.caption: Sparse, not empty: 669,919 people (2011 census)

beats.say: The main limit is water: about one hundred and eighty-five millimetres of rain a year.
beats.caption: Main limit: water · ≈185 mm of rain a year

beats.say: Groundwater can be a hundred and twenty-four metres down, and often saltier deeper.
beats.caption: Groundwater down to 124 m · often saltier deeper (CGWB)

beats.say: Eleven percent of the land, under one percent of the people. Mainly, water.
